title: Alien propulsion via electromagnetic energy and time

tellings.quote: the um it had to do with electromagnetic energy and and time.

plain: The alien craft are said to move by working with electromagnetic energy and with time itself. This comes from a former Army sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the National Security Agency, the US government's signals spy agency, hired him to communicate with aliens in the early 1990s. He tells it as what he learned at a place he calls Base 2, and he links it to Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada.
